description: Figure 5, titled "Enhanced GCG task dependence," is a line chart that illustrates the performance of the Enhanced GCG method across different downstream tasks. The chart plots accuracy on the vertical axis, which ranges from 0.3 to 0.6, against the number of finetuning samples on the horizontal axis, which includes the values 0, 5, 10, and 50. Four distinct lines, each with a different style and color, represent different combinations of evaluation and deployment data formats: "MCQ Unlearn, Corpora Relearn" (solid green), "Corpora Unlearn, Corpora Relearn" (solid orange), "MCQ Unlearn, MCQ Relearn" (dashed green), and "Corpora Unlearn, MCQ Relearn" (dashed orange). The chart shows that the accuracy of the model generally increases with the number of finetuning samples. The "Corpora Unlearn, Corpora Relearn" and "Corpora Unlearn, MCQ Relearn" methods achieve the highest accuracy, reaching approximately 0.6 at 50 samples. In contrast, the "MCQ Unlearn, Corpora Relearn" and "MCQ Unlearn, MCQ Relearn" methods show lower accuracy, with the latter plateauing around 0.4. The caption explains that the effectiveness of Enhanced GCG varies significantly across tasks, with the method nearly recovering the base model's accuracy for maximum letter probability generation but offering little improvement for maximum text generation tasks.
